references.text: Earlier in the story, the Midianite chieftains Oreb and Zeeb are killed, leading to the pursuit of Zebah and Zalmunna.
Gideon pursues Zebah and Zalmunna and asks for bread from the men of Succoth, who refuse because the kings have not yet been captured.
Zebah and Zalmunna ask Gideon to kill them himself, showing their final fate after being taken captive.
The psalm mentions Zebah and Zalmunna by name as examples of enemies God has defeated.
Isaiah refers to 'the day of Midian' as an example of God's victory, which includes the defeat of Zebah and Zalmunna.
Isaiah mentions 'the battle at the rock of Midian' as a reference to Gideon's victory over the Midianites.
